title: France to Shut Up to 500 Schools as Student Protest Movement Intensifies
detail: The French government announced that up to 500 schools would close as the nationwide student protest movement called for further demonstrations. The wave of school blockades and disruptions has forced authorities to shutter hundreds of educational facilities across France.

media.caption: Up to 500 French schools to close as student protests continue

title: Defence Minister Lecornu Orders Lycées to Resume Classes Monday Where Security Permits
detail: Defence Minister Sébastien Lecornu issued orders for lycées to resume classes from Monday wherever security conditions permit, as blockades by student protesters continued to persist at schools across France. The directive signals the government's intent to restore normal operations amid the ongoing protest movement.

media.caption: Lecornu demands lycées resume classes Monday where security permits
